description: The most a grant of each action may allow, whatever the asker asks: the store verbs and the key operations (actors/policy/src/decide.rs, ACTIONS). policy (Rust, actors/policy/tests/service.rs) holds its table to this file; the stand-in for policy in session's tests (Go, actors/session/internal/sessiond/fakes_test.go) narrows the grant it gives to it. A test of session that gets a wider grant than the real policy gives is a test that hides a refusal: token.issue once had no mac here while session asked for it, and the first pairwise key of a tenant could not be made.
